name: Sebring International Raceway (Full Course)

career.lengthSource: Wikipedia circuit profile (official site refused automated requests; SCCA sheets print 3.74) | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sebring_International_Raceway
career.layoutCall: Full course, 17 turns, 3.74 mi (6.019 km): SCCA Hoosier Super Tour, January 2019 (research notes item 6; Sebring has not been repaved since). OSM loop through every named corner (Sunset Bend, Ullman Straight, Le Mans Curve, Gendebien, Bishop, Tower, Collier, Cunningham, Fangio, Hairpin, Gurney); it measures 5872 m, 2.4% under the published length, OSM's line being drawn with few nodes.
